name: Sunadokei to Kan'youshokubutsu no Aru Fuukei
original_name: 砂時計と観葉植物のある風景
source:
In August 2004 the whole Japan is excited with the Athens Olympics.
One day before the end of the summer main character goes to the sea with his friends.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
